focus: Political Links to Big Five Cartel

politicians.name: Senzo Mchunu
allegations: Disbanded the KZN Political Killings Task Team (PKTT) on Dec 31, 2024, allegedly to protect cartel interests.
Met with Vusimuzi 'Cat' Matlala and Brown Mogotsi to discuss funding for political ambitions (alleged by Bheki Cele).
Interfered with anti-cartel investigations (alleged by Nhlanhla Mkhwanazi).
politicians.status: Suspended as of 2025; claims actions were intended to stop corruption.

politicians.name: Bheki Cele
allegations: Accepted R500,000 in bribes for protection from Vusimuzi 'Cat' Matlala (alleged by Matlala).
Testified against Mchunu regarding meetings with the cartel, though some financial allegations were later cited as a 'data analysis error'.
politicians.status: Testified before Madlanga Commission and Ad Hoc Committee.

middlemen.name: Brown Mogotsi
middlemen.description: North West businessman; alleged middleman between Matlala and Senzo Mchunu for political funding.

syndicate: Big Five Cartel (Gauteng-based; involved in drug trafficking, contract killings, and tender fraud).
